candidates.title: Cumulative Violent Crime Reduction - 2006 to 2014
candidates.description: This dataset tracks the cumulative statewide reductions in violent crime since 2006. Data are reported each year by MSAC, the Maryland Statistical Analysis Center, within GOCCP, the Governor's Office of Crime Control and Prevention.

candidates.title: Violent Crimes by County: 2006 to 2013
candidates.description: This dataset shows the total number of violent crimes by county and statewide, for CY2006 versus CY2013. Data are provided by the Maryland Statistical Analysis Center (MSAC) within the Governor's Office of Crime Control and Prevention (GOCCP).

candidates.title: Violent Crime & Property Crime Statewide Totals: 2006 to Present
candidates.description: This dataset shows Maryland crime versus all other states. The data are provided are the Maryland Statistical Analysis Center (MSAC), within the Governor's Office of Crime Control and Prevention (GOCCP). MSAC, in turn, receives these data from the FBI's annual Uniform Crime Reports.

candidates.title: Age-Adjusted Death Rates by Selected Causes of Death among Maryland Residents
candidates.description:
This is historical data. The update frequency has been set to "Static Data" and is here for historic value. Updated 8/14/2024. 

Rate of deaths per 100,000 population by selected underlying causes of death among Maryland residents (1992-2017).

candidates.title: DPSCS Facility-Specific Data Template - 2005 to 2015
candidates.description: The Department of Public Safety and Correctional Services (DPSCS) submits these data to the Governor's Office each month for each of Maryland's prisons and jails. This dataset shows totals across those facilities: population totals, contraband seizures, searches, assaults, hearing officer reports, disciplinary action, identification document issuance, and IWIF statistics. Statistical analyses and data formatting are performed by Department of Information Technology (DoIT).
